name: Taira no Kiyomori
source:
Leader of the Heike. After his successes in the Hogen and Heiji revolts, he rose to a position of power with great influence over politics.
His influence is enormous and he now reigns at the top of the world while maintaining a cooperative relationship with the Inin.
